title: data analyst / data analytics
description:
Roles and Responsibilities:
Extract, manipulate, and analyze large datasets from various sources such as Hive, SQL databases, and BI tools.
Develop and maintain dashboards using Tableau to provide insights on banking performance, market trends, and customer behavior.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify key performance indicators (KPIs) and develop data visualizations to drive business decisions.
Desired Candidate Profile:
610 years of experience in Data Analytics or related fields such as Banking Analytics, Business Intelligence, Campaign Analytics, or Marketing Analytics.
Strong proficiency in tools like Tableau for data visualization; advanced SQL knowledge preferred.
Experience working with big data technologies such as the Hadoop ecosystem (Hive), Spark.
Familiarity with Python programming language.
skills: Banking analytics Ask ChatGPT, Tableau, Sql, Hive, Spark, Python, Data Analytics
